threenative.reason: Deliberately unfilled. The tested TN commit, native build flags, browser build and browser identity are frozen only at publication qualification (Phase 6), not at planning. The reviewed snapshot e0aa293127feebfc07e0874b7b6b3fa8697e157d is a planning reference, not the tested commit.

bevyDependencyLock.reason: bevy commits no Cargo.lock at v0.19.0 (GitHub contents API returns 404 for Cargo.lock at c6f634ca9f406d68ba5109d921247b654cb42c10), so there is no upstream lockfile to hash. The resolved lock must be captured as a hashed execution-lock artifact when the Bevy adapters are built; until then the dependency graph of any Bevy arm is not reproducible.

bevyAssetServerPin.reason: Retired as redundant, not carried as an open input. The only remote asset host a Bevy arm could reach for is https://bevy.org/assets/ (GitHub Pages), and no arm in this campaign fetches from it: the fox family takes `assets/models/animated/Fox.glb` from bevy's own in-repo tree, already pinned at inputs.bevyFoxAsset (c6f634ca9f406d68ba5109d921247b654cb42c10), and the city family takes its Kenney kits from bevyengine/bevy_asset_files, now pinned at open.cityAssetPin. Recorded observation, kept only to explain why the host is not a candidate: that host returns HTTP 404 for models/animated/Fox.glb (re-confirmed 2026-09-27), so it could not serve the fox family unmodified anyway.

cityAssetPin.reason: Frozen as this campaign's city asset SOURCE input, replacing the moving-main null. Upstream leaves bevy_city fetching https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy_asset_files/raw/main/kenney, a moving main in a separate repository that bevy v0.19.0 does not pin, so the commit above is now the input identity for the Kenney bytes. This pins the SOURCE only: it does not by itself byte-lock what a city arm loads, and it does not close the census or fixture boxes below. Enforcement is still the open export box — upstream `assets.rs` hardcodes `const BASE_URL` with no CLI or env override (line 4, consumed as `let base_url = BASE_URL;` in `load_assets`), so a campaign arm must prefetch from the commit-addressed URLs above or vendor them, which is the same canonical-fixture export PRD 5.1 already asks for.
